metaDescription: French Spaniel vaccine schedule with core ages in weeks. Set reminders so French Spaniel boosters are not missed.

bodySections.heading: Why timing matters for this schedule
paragraphs: French Spaniel owners tracking 10-14 years lifespans still lose the mid-series booster more often than the first shot, and the unprotected gap after week 8 is where parvovirus risk concentrates for this puppy.
Use the 4-row French Spaniel schedule as your only planning spine: 8 weeks (DA2PP / DHPP); 12 weeks (DA2PP / DHPP booster); 16 weeks (DA2PP / DHPP booster); 16 weeks (Rabies).

Temperament note for French Spaniel handling: Continental gun dog; ears after fieldwork.. Schedule quieter appointment slots if that profile makes clinic visits harder, but do not skip the French Spaniel dose.
Lifestyle add-ons stay off this French Spaniel core list until your veterinarian maps exposure, so keep core dates sacred either way.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: Owners postpone French Spaniel shots when the puppy seems “a little off,” travel intervenes, or hip dysplasia worries dominate the week — ask the clinic whether a same-week French Spaniel make-up is still appropriate instead of sliding to the annual exam.
Long gaps can leave French Spaniel antibody levels uncertain, so expect either an added booster or a titer conversation rather than a shrug.
Do not trade the missed French Spaniel dose for extra socialization; finish immunity first for this large dog.
Reset the French Spaniel reminder stack the evening of the make-up appointment — including the eventual adult booster after the 16-week finish.

faqs.question: When does the French Spaniel core vaccine series usually finish?
faqs.answer: This breed record completes core vaccines around 16 weeks of age, with rabies timed per local law. Your clinic may adjust intervals for the individual puppy.

faqs.question: What should I do if my French Spaniel misses a booster?
faqs.answer: Contact your veterinarian for a catch-up plan instead of restarting or skipping ahead. Keep prior dates handy and limit high-risk exposure until the series is current again.

faqs.question: Where can I read French Spaniel health context beyond vaccines?
faqs.answer: See the French Spaniel adult health guide for breed predispositions such as hip dysplasia, then bring those notes to wellness and vaccine visits.
